task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Navigate to box stack, remove BOX_TOP to TEMP_TABLE to satisfy stack constraint, pick BOX_MIDDLE and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE, then retrieve BOX_TOP from TEMP_TABLE and place it back on BOX_BOTTOM to restore the stack without the middle box.
assumptions: BOX_TOP must be removed first because only the top box of a stack can be picked.
TEMP_TABLE is a valid temporary location for BOX_TOP.
INSPECTION_TABLE is the target destination for BOX_MIDDLE.
BOX_BOTTOM remains stationary as the base of the stack.
